steps.en: Install PyTorch, the small helpers, then this repo as a package
steps.zh: 装好 PyTorch 和几个小依赖，再把本仓库装成包

steps.en: Downloads and caches the weights on first use; returns the model plus its image transform
steps.zh: 首次使用时下载并缓存权重，返回模型和配套的图像预处理

steps.en: Preprocess your images and write the candidate labels as plain text
steps.zh: 预处理图片，把候选标签写成普通文本

steps.en: Encodes images and texts into one shared vector space
steps.zh: 把图片和文本编码进同一个向量空间

component.zh: 图像编码器 + 文本编码器

steps.en: Scores every image-text pair by cosine similarity; the top label is the zero-shot prediction
steps.zh: 按余弦相似度给每个图文对打分，最高分标签即零样本预测

value.en: Classify or search images by writing labels as text — no labeled dataset, no training run
value.zh: 把标签写成文字就能给图片分类、检索，不用标注数据也不用训练

sources: https://github.com/openai/CLIP#usage (pip install git+https://github.com/openai/CLIP.git, clip.load("ViT-B/32", device=device), clip.tokenize(["a diagram", "a dog", "a cat"]))
https://github.com/openai/CLIP#api (clip.load downloads the model as necessary and returns the TorchVision transform; model(image, text) returns cosine similarities times 100)
